Name: Residential Service Time of Use
Source:
Available throughout the area served by the Cooperative to individual residences and individually
metered dwelling units in multiple-occupancy buildings where the use is for residential purposes and for
farm operations where electricity for both farm and residential purposes is delivered through the same
meter, subject to the established rules and regulations of the Cooperative. Without the written permission
of the Cooperative, the rated capacity of single-phase motors shall not be in excess of five horsepower.
Customer must have service provided through a Cooperative-installed AMI meter. Customer must be
receiving Standard Offer Service (SOS) from the Cooperative. A customer may switch between
Residential service and Residential Time of Use (R-TOU) service. Schedule R-TOU is not available to
customers served by an alternative Electricity Supplier. A customer on R-TOU changing to service from
an alternative Electricity Supplier will be moved to Schedule R. Switches to TOU and off of TOU will
occur at the next meter read date after a Customer requests the switch
